kit.title: Coworker gifts, sorted by how well you know them
kit.hook: Picture this: office gift swap tomorrow, and you drew Steve. Who is Steve?

scenes.narration: Picture this: the office gift swap is tomorrow, and you drew Steve. You have said four words to Steve. Two were "good morning."
scenes.visual: b-roll:an office gift-swap sign-up sheet with one name circled

scenes.narration: Barely know them? Something they use up: a tea sampler, a candle or a snack box.
scenes.onScreen: Barely know them? Use it up

scenes.narration: Sit near them? A heated mug. HGTV named the OHOM Ui Plus its best for the office.
scenes.onScreen: Best for the office: OHOM Ui
scenes.visual: product:OHOM Ui Plus mug on its pad

scenes.narration: It warms to 130 degrees on its pad, with no battery and no app to pair.
scenes.visual: product:OHOM Ui mug on a desk

scenes.narration: The gym-goer? Owala says the FreeSip keeps drinks cold for 24 hours, with a leak-proof lid.
Whole team? One identical gift per desk, so nobody compares.
scenes.visual: product:a row of small desk plants

scenes.narration: And skip the joke gift. Half the office will not laugh.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a gag gift slowly slid back into a drawer

scenes.narration: Next morning, Steve's tea is on his desk, and you have said five words to Steve. Progress. The full list is at the link.
